prompt: Illustrate Android architecture excluding the application (app) layer. List the other five layers and at least two components in each layer.
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 matches the expected 5-layer Android architecture (excluding the app layer) and provides at least two reasonable components per layer, with minimal questionable extra claims. Candidate 3 and 4 also list the correct five layers with sufficient components, but both include additional highly suspect/likely incorrect factual assertions beyond what the prompt requires. Candidate 2’s layer breakdown is internally inconsistent (it places HAL as a component under the Linux Kernel layer and also introduces an extra “Libraries Layer” concept that blurs the standard 5-layer model).
